spells.notes: Appointed in the 1987-05-26 개각 after the 박종철 affair, with the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1987-05-26). The 대한민국사연표 files the reshuffle under 1987-05-25 (tcct_1987_05_25_0010), one day before every other source. Still in office when 노태우 took office on 1988-02-25, so a 전두환-era caretaker holdover. The whole 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24, and the new President accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). end_reason 'resigned' records that formal acceptance. He was reappointed by 노태우 the same morning (next spell), so the two spells are one continuous stay in office. The ministry page merges both into one row numbered '36,37대' (1987.05.26 ~ 1988.12.04), and ko.wikipedia lists 제36대 to 1988-02-24 and 제37대 from 1988-02-25. This file ends the first spell on 1988-02-25, the day the resignation was accepted, following the same-day handover convention of the main justice file. No gazette files exist before 2001.

spells.notes: Reappointed on inauguration day. 노태우 as 대통령당선인 named him on 1988-02-19 as one of seven ministers of the 5공 cabinet kept in the new cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명, per 동아일보 and 중앙일보 1988-02-19). The ministry page gives 1988-12-04 as the last day (day-before convention), and this file uses the handover day. He later served as 대통령 비서실장 (ministry 약력 page, not used for dates).

spells.notes: Named on 1990-03-17 while a visiting scholar at Harvard, returned on the evening of 1990-03-18 (경향신문 1990-03-19) and received the 임명장 with the other new ministers on the morning of 1990-03-19. Start is the 임명장 day, which the ministry page and the pages of the other ministries in the same reshuffle (내무부, 보건사회부, 총무처, 동력자원부, 과학기술처, 통일원) also print. The 대한민국사연표 files the reshuffle under the 1990-03-17 announcement. Replaced in the 1991-05-26 개각 after the 노재봉 cabinet fell. The ministry page prints the end as '1991.05.2' (truncated in the HTML), and ko.wikipedia gives 1991-05-26, the announcement day. This file ends the spell on 1991-05-27, when the successor received the 임명장 (inferred_from_successor). He later served as 감사원장 (ministry 약력 page). Verifier: 한겨레 1991-05-28 says the four ministers of the 1991-05-26 개각 were '임명·발령' on the afternoon of 1991-05-26, while 세계일보 and 중앙일보 put the 임명장 on 1991-05-27 and the 법무부 and 동력자원부 pages print 1991-05-27. The end is kept on the 임명장 day as in the other reshuffles.

spells.notes: Former 법제처장. Named on the afternoon of 1997-03-05 in the 고건 cabinet reshuffle and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1997-03-06, the day of his 취임사 (경향신문 1997-03-07). The ministry page and the 내무부, 총무처 and 과학기술처 pages print 1997-03-06. The 대통령기록관 schedule for 1997-03-05 misspells him as '최상화'. Replaced in the 1997-08-05 개각. End is set to the start of the successor 김종구 as recorded in the main file (1997-08-05). The 임명장 of that reshuffle was given on the morning of 1997-08-06 (서울신문 1997-08-07, 조선일보 1997-08-06), and four other ministries' pages print 1997-08-06 for their holders, so the true handover day may be 1997-08-06. See issues (severity high). The ministry page lists 1997-08-04 as his last day. Verifier: end disputed. The 1997-08-05 value is kept because it is tied to the start of the from_main spell 김종구, which this file must not change, and moving it alone would create a one-day overlap. Evidence for 1997-08-05: the announcement and 임명 on the afternoon of 1997-08-05 (국민일보, 문화일보, 경향신문 1997-08-06), 김종구's farewell at 서울고검 that day (경향신문 1997-08-06 p.2), and the 법무부 page (김종구 from 1997.08.05). Evidence for 1997-08-06: the 임명장 at 09:30 on 1997-08-06 (매일신문 1997-08-06, 동아일보 1997-08-06 p.1, 서울신문 1997-08-07, 조선일보 1997-08-06), and the 역대 장관 pages of 교육부, 내무부, 총무처 and 환경부, which start their holders of the same reshuffle on 1997-08-06. In every other reshuffle of the window this file dates the handover by the 임명장.

issues.desc: from_main spell 김종구 (start 1997-08-05, main file justice.verified.json) may start on 1997-08-06. The 1997-08-05 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1997-08-05, and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1997-08-06 (서울신문 1997-08-07 BigKinds 01100611.20160421115451026 '김영삼 대통령은 6일 상오 청와대에서 조해령 내무·김종구 법무 등 ‘8·5’개각에서 새로 임명된 11명의 각료들에게 임명장을 주었다', and 조선일보 1997-08-06 News Library 1997080600239101004 and 경향신문, 한국일보 1997-08-06 announce the 6일 오전 임명장). Four other ministries' 역대 장관 pages print 1997-08-06 as the start for the same reshuffle (교육부 이명현, 내무부 조해녕, 총무처 심우영, 환경부 윤여준, see ext88/crossministry.json). In the other reshuffles of this window where announcement and 임명장 fell on different days (1990-03-17/19, 1991-05-26/27, 1994-12-23/24, 1997-03-05/06), the 법무부 page prints the 임명장 day. Only for 김종구 does it print the announcement day (1997.08.05). The main record was left unchanged and 최상엽's end in this file is tied to it (1997-08-05). If the start of 김종구 is moved to 1997-08-06, 최상엽's end and the 김종구 nomination outcome_date should move with it.

Convention for ministers reappointed at the 1988-02-25 transition. The 5공 cabinet's blanket resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and the new President appointed the whole new cabinet the same morning, seven of them reappointed (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명, per 동아일보 1988-02-19). This file splits 정해창 into a 전두환 spell ending 1988-02-25 (end_reason resigned) and a 노태우 spell starting 1988-02-25, as the 법무부 page (36,37대), the 내무부 page (이상희 48대 to 1988-02-24, 49대 from 1988-02-25) and ko.wikipedia do. The 체신부 list on the msit page does not split 오명. Other ext88 lineages should use one convention for all seven, and the builder may want a flag that joins the pair into one appointment (reorg_continuation is false here because this is not a reorganization).

Announcement day against 임명장 day. In five reshuffles the press reported the appointment on one day and the 임명장 on the next (1990-03-17/19, 1991-05-26/27, 1994-12-23/24, 1997-03-05/06, 1997-08-05/06). Starts here follow the 임명장 day, which the 법무부 page and the other ministries' pages also print (except 김종구, see the high issue). The 대한민국사연표 and ko.wikipedia sometimes use the announcement day (연표 1987-05-25 for the 1987-05-26 개각, wiki 1991-05-26 for 이종남's end). nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day.

Ministry page end dates are the day before the successor's start. This file follows the main justice file and ends each replaced holder on the successor's start day. Where the outgoing minister is known to have been in office that day (정해창 at the 1988-12-05 morning 국무회의) or his resignation was accepted that day (박희태 1993-03-08, 정해창 1988-02-25) the end is high. Otherwise it is inferred_from_successor. For 김기춘 (1992-10-09) the acceptance is implied by the return of the other ministers' blanket resignations that day, so medium.

The 법무부 page prints 이종남's term as '1990.03.19 ~ 1991.05.2' in the HTML itself, with the end day truncated. ko.wikipedia gives 1991-05-26. This file ends the spell on 1991-05-27 (successor's 임명장). The 약력 page (moj profile 178) has no dates.

Every month from 1987-05 to 1998-03 was searched for '법무장관' in the News Library and for '법무부장관' in BigKinds, and the name most often written right before the title was taken as the sitting minister.
